test_title: PYST 4: SSC MTS 2023 - English (Held On: 04 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the sentence that has NO spelling errors.

options.text: The teacher was impressed with the student’s insightfull analysis of the novel, which demonstrated a deep understanding of the complex theames and motifs.
The teacher was impressed with the student’s insightful analysis of the novel, which demonstrated a deep understanding of the complex themes and motifs.
The teacher was imprresed with the student’s insightul analysis of the novel, which demonstrated a deep understanding of the complex themes and motifes.
The teacher was impresed with the student’s insightful analysis of the novel, which demonstreted a deep understanding of the complex themes and motifs.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"insightful"** means having or showing a deep understanding and intelligent application of knowledge. (अंतरदृष्टिपूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example: **Her insightful comments during the discussion showcased her deep understanding of the topic.
 
 
 
• The word **"themes"** refers to the central topics or underlying messages in a piece of writing or other artistic work. (विषयवस्तु)
 
 
• **Example: **The novel explores complex themes such as identity, freedom, and morality.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** The teacher was impressed with the student’s insightfull analysis of the novel, which demonstrated a deep understanding of the complex theames and motifs. (अंतरदृष्टिपूर्ण विश्लेषण)
 
 
• **Error:** "insightfull" should be "insightful", "theames" should be "themes".
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** The teacher was imprresed with the student’s insightul analysis of the novel, which demonstrated a deep understanding of the complex themes and motifes. (प्रभावित)
 
 
• **Error:** "imprresed" should be "impressed", "insightul" should be "insightful", "motifes" should be "motifs".
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** The teacher was impresed with the student’s insightful analysis of the novel, which demonstreted a deep understanding of the complex themes and motifs. (प्रभावित)
 
 
• **Error:** "impresed" should be "impressed", "demonstreted" should be "demonstrated".
 
 

33:Tb56,

The correct answer is: **Option 2**.
